faq_heading: Homes near Burnsview Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Burnsview Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Burnsview Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Burnsview Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Burnsview Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Chalmers Elementary (0.2 km south-east), Heath Elementary (0.9 km south) and Sands Secondary (1.1 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Burnsview Secondary

22 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Burnsview Secondary in a straight line (18 elementary, 4 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Chalmers Elementary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Immaculate Conception School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Sands Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (2.7 km). Other secondary schools close by: Sands Secondary (1.1 km north-west), North Delta Secondary (1.4 km north), Delta Continuing Education (1.5 km north-east), Seaquam Secondary (1.8 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Sands Secondary, 1.1 km north-west of Burnsview Secondary.
